supplements.title: Reduced Versus Oxidized NAD+ Precursors Drive Distinct Transcriptomic, Proteomic, and Metabolic Profiles in Hepatocytes.
supplements.summary: Reduced NAD+ precursors boost cellular NAD+ levels more potently than standard versions and trigger broader metabolic changes in liver cells.

supplements.title: Germacrone Alleviates Cisplatin-Induced Nephrotoxicity by Activating PI3K/Akt Signaling, Inhibiting Ras/MAPK Signaling, and Regulating Macrophage Polarization.
supplements.summary: Germacrone protects kidneys from cisplatin chemotherapy damage without reducing the drug's cancer-fighting effects in breast cancer.

supplements.title: Koumine from Gelsemium elegans Benth suppresses colorectal cancer metastasis by inhibiting vasculogenic mimicry formation through epithelial-mesenchymal transition and cytoskeleton remodeling.
supplements.summary: Koumine, a plant compound, stops colorectal cancer spread by blocking abnormal blood vessel formation and preventing cancer cells from becoming mobile.

supplements.title: Dose-dependent biphasic reversal of ABC transporter-mediated multidrug resistance by natural dihydrochalcone via P-glycoprotein suppression.
supplements.summary: A natural compound from plants suppresses P-glycoprotein to reverse drug resistance in cancer cells at specific doses.

supplements.title: Flavonoid diversity across six Ocimum accessions: UPLC-MS/MS metabolomics and RNA-seq reveal anticancer leads and nutraceutical potential.
supplements.summary: Three flavonoid compounds from Ocimum plants show promise against cancer by targeting multiple cancer-related proteins and pathways.

supplements.title: Mechanistic insights into the antioxidant activity of sorghum bran phenolics via compositional profiling, network pharmacology and molecular docking.
supplements.summary: Sorghum bran's phenolic compounds may fight cancer by blocking the PI3K-AKT signaling pathway through interactions with key cancer-related proteins.

supplements.title: Electroacupuncture combined with fruquintinib and sintilimab in microsatellite-stable metastatic colorectal cancer: A phase II study.
supplements.summary: Electroacupuncture combined with two cancer drugs improved tolerability while maintaining effectiveness against treatment-resistant colorectal cancer.

supplements.title: Evaluation of the mechanism underlying melatonin action in cholestatic liver disease treatment via network pharmacology, molecular docking, and in vivo experiments.
supplements.summary: Melatonin reduces inflammation and fibrosis in cholestatic liver disease by modulating MMP9 and EGFR/AKT signaling pathways.

supplements.title: Skeletal Diversity of Diterpenoids Isolated from the Soft Coral Sclerophytum heterospiculatum in Kikai Island.
supplements.summary: Researchers isolated five new compounds from soft coral that showed cytotoxic activity against human cancer cell lines.

supplements.title: Farnesol Targets the GSTP1/MAPK Axis to Inhibit Trauma-Induced Tendon Heterotopic Ossification.
supplements.summary: Farnesol, a natural compound, prevents abnormal bone formation in injured tendons by blocking the GSTP1/MAPK signaling pathway.

supplements.title: Serum vitamin D and lean non-alcoholic fatty liver disease: a nonlinear 'L-shaped' association in a national cross-sectional study.
supplements.summary: Low vitamin D levels show a strong link to lean non-alcoholic fatty liver disease in a national study.

supplements.title: Curcumin for the Treatment of Inflammatory Bowel Disease: From Mechanism to Clinic.
supplements.summary: Curcumin, a natural compound, shows promise in treating inflammatory bowel disease by reducing inflammation and improving patient symptoms.

supplements.title: NAD+ Homeostasis Attenuates Japanese Encephalitis Virus Infection Progression.
supplements.summary: Restoring NAD+ levels with nicotinamide riboside supplementation reduces Japanese encephalitis virus replication and improves infection outcomes.

supplements.title: Circulating Myokine Responses to Acute Endurance Exercise and Their Role in Immunoregulation: A Systematic Review and Meta-Analysis.
supplements.summary: Endurance exercise increases protective immune molecules (myokines) in the blood, offering potential therapeutic benefits across various diseases.

supplements.title: Association between Japanese diet and the risk of cancer incidence: data from the Ohsaki Cohort Study.
supplements.summary: A traditional Japanese diet showed no significant association with cancer risk in a 14-year study of over 25,000 adults.

off_label.title: LKB1-AMPK Signaling Pathway in Cardiovascular and Other Diseases.
off_label.summary: The LKB1-AMPK pathway regulates cellular energy and is dysregulated in cardiovascular disease, cancer, diabetes, and neurodegeneration, offering therapeutic targets.

off_label.title: Lidocaine potentiates thermal ablation in cholangiocarcinoma by modulating TRPV6-Driven Ca2+/PI3K/AKT/HSF-1 signaling pathway.
off_label.summary: Lidocaine enhances heat treatment effectiveness in bile duct cancer by blocking a calcium channel that normally helps tumors survive heat stress.

off_label.title: NCAPH promotes immune evasion via inhibiting PD-L1 protein degradation in head and neck squamous cell carcinoma.
off_label.summary: NCAPH protein helps head and neck cancer evade immunity by stabilizing PD-L1; blocking this interaction or degrading NCAPH restores immune response.

off_label.title: Lactic acid promotes an MDSC-like phenotype via HIF1α stabilization with impact on prognosis in renal cell carcinoma.
off_label.summary: Tumor-derived lactate promotes immune-suppressing myeloid cells in kidney cancer, and blocking lactate transport may restore anti-tumor immunity.

off_label.title: SRC at the crossroads of KRAS inhibitor resistance: Mechanisms and therapeutic opportunities.
off_label.summary: SRC protein drives resistance to KRAS inhibitors in lung, colon, and pancreatic cancers; targeting SRC could restore drug effectiveness.

off_label.title: DADA Enhances CD8+ T Cell Stemness to Improve Anti-Tumor Immunity and Immunotherapy Efficacy.
off_label.summary: DADA enhances immune T cells' ability to fight cancer by improving their stem-like properties and boosting immunotherapy effectiveness.

off_label.title: ARID1A Deficiency in Diffuse-Type Gastric Cancer Promotes a Pyrimidine Metabolic Vulnerability.
off_label.summary: ARID1A-deficient gastric cancer has a metabolic weakness that makes it vulnerable to Gemcitabine chemotherapy treatment.

off_label.title: Machine Learning-Informed Nano Co-Assembly Inhibits Fibroblast Activation Protein and Improves Drug Delivery in Fibrotic Tissue.
off_label.summary: Researchers used machine learning to develop nanoparticles that better deliver drugs through fibrotic tissue barriers, improving treatment for fibrosis-related diseases.

off_label.title: Mutant SRSF2-associated impaired erythropoiesis is defined by increased mTORC1 signaling due to FYN missplicing.
off_label.summary: SRSF2 mutations in blood cancers impair red blood cell production by increasing mTORC1 signaling; mTORC1 inhibitors may restore blood cell formation.

off_label.title: Targeting de novo pyrimidine synthesis confers vulnerability to copper-mediated ATR inactivation in PARP inhibitor-resistant ovarian cancer.
off_label.summary: Blocking pyrimidine synthesis combined with copper and PARP inhibitors overcomes drug resistance in ovarian cancer.

off_label.title: Sparsentan for the Treatment of VEGF Signaling Pathway Inhibitor-Associated Proteinuria
off_label.summary: Sparsentan reduces severe protein loss in urine caused by cancer drugs that block blood vessel growth.

off_label.title: A Phase I Trial of Azacitidine and Abatacept in Relapsed or Refractory T-Cell Lymphoma
off_label.summary: Researchers test whether combining azacitidine and abatacept drugs can shrink tumors in people with relapsed or refractory T-cell lymphoma.

off_label.title: IL-1 Receptor Antagonist to Prevent Severe Chimeric Antigen Receptor T-Cell Related Encephalopathy Syndrome
off_label.summary: Anakinra may prevent severe brain inflammation in large B-cell lymphoma patients receiving CAR T-cell therapy.

off_label.title: A Phase 1 Study of the Polymerase Theta (POLθ) Inhibitor Novobiocin in BRCA- Mutant and Other DNA Damage Repair-Deficient Solid Tumors
off_label.summary: Novobiocin, a DNA polymerase theta inhibitor, is tested to treat solid tumors with DNA repair gene mutations.

off_label.title: Drug repurposing of ticagrelor suppresses renal cell carcinoma growth by blockading the EGFR/PI3K/AKT axis.
off_label.summary: Ticagrelor, an antiplatelet drug, slows kidney cancer growth by blocking a key cancer-promoting pathway.

biomarkers.title: Exploring the gut microbiome and metabolomic interactions of antimetabolite drugs to optimize therapy.
biomarkers.summary: Gut bacteria influence how antimetabolite cancer drugs work and cause side effects; understanding these interactions could improve treatment outcomes.

biomarkers.title: Multidimensional immune profiling uncovers biphasic peripheral T-cell dynamics after chemoradiation in patients with locally advanced head and neck cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Head and neck cancer patients show suppressed immune responses one month after chemotherapy, but robust tumor-fighting T-cells emerge by three months.

biomarkers.title: TNF-α deficiency underlies NK cell dysfunction in colorectal cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Low TNF-α levels in colorectal cancer patients impair natural killer cell function, suppressing the immune response against tumors.

biomarkers.title: Monocytes acquire a tumor-associated IL1B program upon encountering patient-derived colon cancer organoids.
biomarkers.summary: Colon cancer cells reprogram monocytes to suppress immune responses through soluble factors and debris uptake in tumor microenvironments.

biomarkers.title: Aging-caused the changes of the gut microbiota drive intestinal barrier dysfunction and increase sepsis susceptibility.
biomarkers.summary: Aging alters gut bacteria to produce histamine, damaging intestinal barriers and worsening sepsis severity; targeting this pathway may help treat sepsis.

biomarkers.title: Single-cell RNA sequencing analysis of bone cancer pain model induced by Lewis lung cancer cells in male mice.
biomarkers.summary: Researchers used single-cell analysis to identify molecular changes in bone cancer pain caused by lung cancer in mice.

biomarkers.title: Opportunities and challenges for cancer immunotherapy based on antigen cross-presentation.
biomarkers.summary: Tumors evade immune attacks by blocking two pathways: reducing antigen presentation and suppressing dendritic cells through immunosuppressive factors.

biomarkers.title: From spectroscopic analysis to clinical imaging: emerging applications and persistent challenges of raman spectroscopy in CTCs-based liquid biopsies.
biomarkers.summary: Raman spectroscopy enables non-invasive detection and analysis of circulating tumor cells in blood for improved cancer diagnosis and monitoring.

biomarkers.title: Tertiary lymphoid structures guided opportunities and challenges for immunotherapy in early gastroesophageal junction cancer and low rectal cancer.
biomarkers.summary: Early gastroesophageal and rectal cancers show immune-active tumors with structures that could guide immunotherapy to potentially preserve organs instead of surgery.

biomarkers.title: Targeting FMO3 suppresses the malignant phenotype of colorectal cancer: evidence from bioinformatics to functional experiments.
biomarkers.summary: Blocking FMO3 protein reduces the aggressiveness of colorectal cancer cells, offering a potential new treatment target.

biomarkers.title: KCMF1 promotes malignant progression by NXN ubiquitin-dependent degradation in ovarian cancer.
biomarkers.summary: KCMF1 protein promotes ovarian cancer growth and spread by breaking down NXN protein, offering a potential new treatment target.

biomarkers.title: A rare case of ectopic cushing's syndrome caused by renal neuroendocrine tumor.
biomarkers.summary: A rare kidney neuroendocrine tumor caused Cushing's syndrome by producing hormone, requiring surgical removal for treatment.

biomarkers.title: Rnd3 regulates lung cancer cell invasion and migration independently of ROCK1 signaling via alpha 5 integrin modulation.
biomarkers.summary: Low Rnd3 levels in lung cancer reduce cell invasion and migration through alpha 5 integrin, offering a new treatment target.

biomarkers.title: HOP2-MND1 chaperones a diffusing DMC1-ssDNA complex to survey dsDNA for homology recognition during meiotic recombination.
biomarkers.summary: Scientists discovered that HOP2-MND1 proteins help DMC1 find matching DNA sequences during meiosis by maintaining expanded DNA structures for proper pairing.

biomarkers.title: Human oncogenic herpesvirus latency proteins activate NEK2 to promote chromosomal instability and tumorigenesis.
biomarkers.summary: Herpes viruses EBV and KSHV activate a protein called NEK2 that causes chromosomal instability and cancer growth.

trials.title: Exploring the gut microbiome and metabolomic interactions of antimetabolite drugs to optimize therapy.
trials.summary: Gut bacteria influence how antimetabolite cancer drugs work and cause side effects; understanding these interactions could improve treatment outcomes.

trials.title: Multidimensional immune profiling uncovers biphasic peripheral T-cell dynamics after chemoradiation in patients with locally advanced head and neck cancer.
trials.summary: Head and neck cancer patients show suppressed immune responses one month after chemotherapy, but robust tumor-fighting T-cells emerge by three months.

trials.title: Tertiary lymphoid structures guided opportunities and challenges for immunotherapy in early gastroesophageal junction cancer and low rectal cancer.
trials.summary: Early gastroesophageal and rectal cancers show immune-active tumors with structures that could guide immunotherapy to potentially preserve organs instead of surgery.

trials.title: Inflammation, Limbic White Matter Microstructure, and Clinical Symptoms in Retired American Football Players With Repetitive Head Impacts.
trials.summary: Repetitive head impacts in retired football players link inflammation and brain changes to cognitive decline and behavioral problems.

trials.title: Breast Fibromatosis in a Patient With a History of Treated Breast Cancer: A Case Report.
trials.summary: A rare benign breast tumor (fibromatosis) developed in a cancer survivor and required surgical removal after radiotherapy failed to control pain and growth.

trials.title: Inhibiting ADAR1-Mediated Excessive Epigenetic A-to-I RNA Editing Improves the Immune Microenvironment and Increases Sensitivity to Immunotherapy in Lung Adenocarcinoma.
trials.summary: Blocking ADAR1 enzyme in lung adenocarcinoma improves immune response and makes immunotherapy more effective in mice and patients.

trials.title: RNA Regulatory Networks: Key Hubs in the Panorama of Cancer and Emerging Therapeutic Targets.
trials.summary: RNA networks control cancer development and progression, offering new precision medicine targets through therapies like antisense oligonucleotides and CRISPR-Cas13.

trials.title: Exceptional Response to a Single Dose of Pembrolizumab as Salvage Therapy for Metastatic Adrenocortical Carcinoma.
trials.summary: A young woman with metastatic adrenocortical carcinoma achieved complete remission after a single pembrolizumab dose, despite severe side effects and unfavorable tumor markers.

trials.title: Allogeneic Hematopoietic Stem Cell Transplantation for Children With Mixed Phenotype Acute Leukemia: A Single-Center Retrospective Study.
trials.summary: Stem cell transplantation improved survival outcomes in children with mixed phenotype acute leukemia, a rare and difficult-to-treat blood cancer.

trials.title: Fatal tracheal perforation following Dabrafenib-Trametinib therapy in BRAF V600E-mutant mixed anaplastic thyroid cancer.
trials.summary: Dabrafenib-Trametinib therapy caused fatal tracheal perforation in a BRAF-mutant thyroid cancer patient due to rapid tumor shrinkage.

trials.title: Self-management of male urinary symptoms: qualitative findings from a primary care trial.
trials.summary: A self-management program in primary care helps men better manage lower urinary tract symptoms compared to standard treatment.

trials.title: The Application of PD-1 Inhibitors in Immunotherapy for Glioblastoma.
trials.summary: PD-1 inhibitors combined with chemotherapy, radiotherapy, or other immunotherapies show promise for treating glioblastoma better than the drug alone.

trials.title: SPP1+ Macrophage-POSTN+ Fibroblast-Endothelial Triad Dictates Immunotherapy Response in Bladder Cancer.
trials.summary: A cellular structure of immune cells, fibroblasts, and blood vessels drives immunotherapy resistance in bladder cancer; blocking SPP1 restores treatment response.

trials.title: CAR-T Cell Exhaustion in Cancer over the Past Decade: Mitochondrial Metabolism as a Target for Counteraction.
trials.summary: Targeting mitochondrial metabolism in CAR-T cells could restore their energy and effectiveness, overcoming exhaustion that limits cancer treatment success.

trials.title: Electroacupuncture combined with fruquintinib and sintilimab in microsatellite-stable metastatic colorectal cancer: A phase II study.
trials.summary: Electroacupuncture combined with two cancer drugs improved tolerability while maintaining effectiveness against treatment-resistant colorectal cancer.
